source: futag-llvm 18.1.8, FutagConsumerAnalyzer with the literal fix
note: The case where the old sort_callexprs was wrong: it put the nested producer cfg_from(o) before obj_modify(o, 7), so the producer read an unconfigured object. The analyzer also records cfg_from(o) twice (FutagRefVar init and modifying call of o), the generator drops the duplicate.
